PROJECT_SUMMARY: a one-person habit tracker PWA with streaks.
STACK: Python 3.12 + FastAPI + SQLite (backend/), React 18 + Vite + Tailwind (frontend/)
CMD_INSTALL: cd backend && python -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt; cd ../frontend && npm ci
PHASES: 0 Foundation · 1 Habits API · 2 Phone UI · 3 Ship (see `tasks.py phase`)
PROJECT_FACTS: Single user: no auth beyond one shared secret header in v1.
